name: Sketchbook: Schoolgirls in Love and Other Assorted Heartbreak
source: A slice-of-life melodrama that's all about the important parts of growing up: falling in love with another girl, impeaching a corrupt student council president, uncomfortable sex, and not colouring within the lines.
